table.role: Harness scripts (run_hermes.py / run_openclaw.py), scoring, audit-log parsing.
Native-Windows agent harness under evaluation; one-shot runs via 'hermes -z'; home %LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes; provider 'ollama'.
Second agent harness under evaluation; runs in WSL Ubuntu-24.04, invoked via 'openclaw agent'.
Shared local model server both harnesses hit (hf.co/unsloth/gpt-oss-20b-GGUF) at 127.0.0.1:11434 — same brain, so the harness is the only variable.
QI-created stdlib-only domain-registration lookup exposed as an MCP tool to both harnesses.
Hosts the OpenClaw install; run_openclaw.py crosses the Windows-WSL boundary via wsl.exe.

descriptions.title: Stack
descriptions.body: Pure-Python eval rig at C:\APPS\QIP\Bakeoff. No service, no port — run on demand. Same gpt-oss-20b brain on both sides; smoke test 10/10 (2026-07-06); Renne runs the full suite and decides.
